title: EverOS Cloud - EverOS
html:
EverOS Cloud is the memory engine for developers. Give every AI product you build (an agent, an assistant, or any AI app) a persistent, self-evolving memory, so a stateless LLM becomes something that remembers and grows, without you operating any memory infrastructure. Today’s models are capable but forgetful: each session resets what they learned about the user, the task, and the mistakes they already made. Stuffing the context window is slow and expensive, and a bolted-on vector store only retrieves, it never learns. EverOS turns conversations, tasks, and domain knowledge into persistent, retrievable, evolving memory, so your product gets more useful the more it is used.

What EverOS gives your product

Self-evolving memory

Records each agent run as a Case and distills recurring Cases into reusable Skills, so your agents get better at a task the more they run it.

User + Agent memory

Two tracks: User Memory (who the user is) and Agent Memory (what the agent has learned). Scope by owner, type, and user / agent / app / project / session.

Remembers any format

Native multimodal: text, images, audio, docs, PDF, HTML, spreadsheets, slides, and email become structured, searchable memory.

Precise retrieval

Keyword, vector, hybrid, or agentic search, resolving coarse Episodes down to atomic Facts for verifiable recall instead of fuzzy summaries.

Full lifecycle control

Add, search, correct, delete, and rate individual memories. Memory is a governable asset you control, not an append-only black box.

Memory Bank

See exactly what’s stored (profiles, episodes, agent cases and skills) in the console, browsable by owner, type, and time.

Cloud and open source, one API

The same API on managed Cloud and self-hosted (Apache-2.0). Move between them for compliance without rewriting code.

How EverOS works (a quick glance)

  • Episodic Trace Formation: EverOS monitors the continuous dialogue stream and uses semantic boundary detection to segment interactions into coherent events.
  • Structured Encoding: For each event, it synthesizes a MemCell containing a concise third-person Episode and atomic Facts.
  • Semantic Consolidation: Instead of flat storage, MemCells are dynamically clustered into thematic MemScenes (e.g., “Health”, “Work”) to capture high-level contexts.
  • Profile Evolution: The system continuously distills these scenes to update a structured User Profile, separating stable traits from temporary states.
  • Reconstructive Recollection: Your agent retrieves context via hybrid search (BM25/vector/RRF) or Agentic Retrieval. EverOS navigates MemScenes, filters for time-valid evidence, and iterates until the retrieved context is “necessary and sufficient.”
  • Grounded Reasoning: The agent uses the returned memories as grounded context to respond and plan, enabling long-horizon reasoning without replaying weeks or months of history in the prompt.

Proven on public benchmarks

  • LoCoMo 93.05% · LongMemEval 83.00% · HaluMem recall 90.04% — memory accuracy and anti-hallucination
  • +234.8% peak task-success lift from the self-evolving skill engine
  • ~450ms P95 latency · >90% fewer tokens than full-context (about 10× lower cost)

Core memory operations

Add Memory

Extract memory from messages and interactions, across text and files.

Get Memory

Precise memory filtering based on owner, type, and metadata fields.

Search Memory

Context-aware retrieval (keyword, vector, hybrid, agentic) across every format.

Correct a Memory

Rewrite one episode’s narrative, summary, or subject when it got something wrong.

Delete by ID

Remove specific memories, and everything derived from them, by id.

Rate a Memory

Record whether a memory was right, so you can track what your users reject.

EverOS Cloud is the memory engine for developers. Give every AI product you build (an agent, an assistant, or any AI app) a persistent, self-evolving memory, so a stateless LLM becomes something that remembers and grows, without you operating any memory infrastructure. Today’s models are capable but forgetful: each session resets what they learned about the user, the task, and the mistakes they already made. Stuffing the context window is slow and expensive, and a bolted-on vector store only retrieves, it never learns. EverOS turns conversations, tasks, and domain knowledge into persistent, retrievable, evolving memory, so your product gets more useful the more it is used.

## What EverOS gives your product

## Self-evolving memory

Records each agent run as a **Case** and distills recurring Cases into reusable
**Skills**, so your agents get better at a task the more they run it.

## User + Agent memory

Two tracks: **User Memory** (who the user is) and **Agent Memory** (what the agent
has learned). Scope by owner, type, and user / agent / app / project / session.

## Remembers any format

Native multimodal: text, images, audio, docs, PDF, HTML, spreadsheets, slides,
and email become structured, searchable memory.

## Precise retrieval

Keyword, vector, hybrid, or agentic search, resolving coarse Episodes down to
atomic **Facts** for verifiable recall instead of fuzzy summaries.

## Full lifecycle control

Add, search, correct, delete, and rate individual memories. Memory is a governable
asset you control, not an append-only black box.

## Memory Bank

See exactly what’s stored (profiles, episodes, agent cases and skills) in the
console, browsable by owner, type, and time.

## Cloud and open source, one API

The same API on managed Cloud and self-hosted (Apache-2.0). Move between them for
compliance without rewriting code.

## How EverOS works (a quick glance)

1. **Episodic Trace Formation**: EverOS monitors the continuous dialogue stream and uses semantic boundary detection to segment interactions into coherent events.
2. **Structured Encoding**: For each event, it synthesizes a **MemCell** containing a concise third-person **Episode** and atomic **Facts**.
3. **Semantic Consolidation**: Instead of flat storage, MemCells are dynamically clustered into thematic **MemScenes** (e.g., “Health”, “Work”) to capture high-level contexts.
4. **Profile Evolution**: The system continuously distills these scenes to update a structured **User Profile**, separating stable traits from temporary states.
5. **Reconstructive Recollection**: Your agent retrieves context via hybrid search (BM25/vector/RRF) or **Agentic Retrieval**. EverOS navigates MemScenes, filters for time-valid evidence, and iterates until the retrieved context is “necessary and sufficient.”
6. **Grounded Reasoning**: The agent uses the returned memories as grounded context to respond and plan, enabling long-horizon reasoning without replaying weeks or months of history in the prompt.

## Proven on public benchmarks

- **LoCoMo 93.05%** · **LongMemEval 83.00%** · **HaluMem recall 90.04%** — memory accuracy and anti-hallucination
- **+234.8%** peak task-success lift from the self-evolving skill engine
- **\~450ms** P95 latency · **>90%** fewer tokens than full-context (about 10× lower cost)

## Core memory operations

## Add Memory

Extract memory from messages and interactions, across text and files.

## Get Memory

Precise memory filtering based on owner, type, and metadata fields.

## Search Memory

Context-aware retrieval (keyword, vector, hybrid, agentic) across every format.

## Correct a Memory

Rewrite one episode’s narrative, summary, or subject when it got something wrong.

## Delete by ID

Remove specific memories, and everything derived from them, by id.

## Rate a Memory

Record whether a memory was right, so you can track what your users reject.
html_zh:
EverOS Cloud 是开发人员的内存引擎。为您构建的每个人工智能产品（代理、助手或任何人工智能应用程序）提供持久的、自我进化的内存，这样无状态的LLM就会成为可以记住和成长的东西，而无需您操作任何内存基础设施。当今的模型功能强大，但容易健忘：每次会话都会重置他们对用户、任务以及已经犯过的错误的了解。填充上下文窗口既缓慢又昂贵，并且固定的向量存储只能检索，而永远不会学习。 EverOS 将对话、任务和领域知识转化为持久的、可检索的、不断发展的记忆，因此您的产品使用得越多，就越有用。

EverOS 为您的产品提供什么

自我进化记忆

将每个代理运行记录为案例，并将重复出现的案例提炼为可重用的技能，因此您的代理运行任务越多，就越能更好地完成任务。

用户+代理记忆

两个轨道：用户记忆（用户是谁）和代理记忆（代理学到了什么）。按所有者、类型和用户/代理/应用程序/项目/会话划分的范围。

记住任何格式

原生多模式：文本、图像、音频、文档、PDF、HTML、电子表格、幻灯片和电子邮件成为结构化、可搜索的内存。

精准检索

关键词、向量、混合或代理搜索，将粗略的情节解析为原子事实，以进行可验证的回忆，而不是模糊的摘要。

全生命周期控制

添加、搜索、更正、删除和评价个人记忆。内存是您可以控制的可管理资产，而不是只能附加的黑匣子。

记忆库

准确查看控制台中存储的内容（个人资料、情节、特工案例和技能），可按所有者、类型和时间浏览。

云和开源，一个 API

托管云和自托管 (Apache-2.0) 上的 API 相同。在它们之间移动以实现合规性，而无需重写代码。

EverOS 的工作原理（快速浏览）

  • 情节跟踪形成：EverOS 监视连续对话流并使用语义边界检测将交互分段为连贯的事件。
  • 结构化编码：对于每个事件，它合成一个包含简洁的第三人称情节和原子事实的 MemCell。
  • 语义整合：MemCell 不是平面存储，而是动态地聚集到主题 MemScene（例如“健康”、“工作”）中以捕获高级上下文。
  • 配置文件演变：系统不断提取这些场景以更新结构化的用户配置文件，将稳定特征与临时状态分开。
  • 重建记忆：您的代理通过混合搜索（BM25/向量/RRF）或代理检索来检索上下文。 EverOS 导航 MemScene，过滤时间有效的证据，并进行迭代，直到检索到的上下文“必要且充分”。
  • 扎根推理：代理使用返回的记忆作为扎根上下文来响应和计划，从而实现长期推理，而无需在提示中重播数周或数月的历史记录。

经过公共基准测试验证

  • LoCoMo 93.05% · LongMemEval 83.00% · HaluMem 召回率 90.04% — 记忆准确度和抗幻觉
  • 自我进化技能引擎使任务成功率提升 234.8%
  • ~450ms P95 延迟 · 比全上下文标记少 90% 以上（成本降低约 10 倍）

核心内存操作

添加内存

从文本和文件中的消息和交互中提取记忆。

获取内存

基于所有者、类型和元数据字段的精确内存过滤。

搜索内存

跨每种格式的上下文感知检索（关键字、向量、混合、代理）。

纠正记忆

当某一集出现问题时，重写其叙述、摘要或主题。

按ID删除

通过本我删除特定的记忆以及源自它们的一切。

评价记忆

记录记忆是否正确，以便您可以跟踪用户拒绝的内容。
summary_zh: 这是 EverOS Cloud 的官方文档总览页：EverOS 是面向开发者的记忆引擎，让 Agent、助手等 AI 产品拥有持久、可自我演进的记忆，而无需自己运维记忆基础设施。它把每次 Agent 运行记录为 Case，再把反复出现的 Case 提炼成可复用的 Skill；记忆分为 User Memory（用户是谁）和 Agent Memory（Agent 学到了什么）两条线，支持文本、图片、音频、PDF、表格、邮件等多种格式。检索支持关键词、向量、混合和 Agentic 搜索，可以从粗粒度的 Episode 精确定位到原子级的 Fact，单条记忆也能新增、查询、更正、删除和评分；托管 Cloud 与 Apache-2.0 自托管版本使用同一套 API。文档列出的公开基准成绩为 LoCoMo 93.05%、LongMemEval 83.00%、HaluMem 召回 90.04%，P95 延迟约 450ms，token 用量比全量上下文少 90% 以上。（原帖是知识猫基于该 API 搭建「交稿记忆台」的合作实测：先保存一次审稿经验，再用新问题检索出来并应用到新稿，换一个身份查询则返回 0 条。）
